Summary:

GULF FRONT - 1 FREE Set of Beach Chairs - Inlet Beach Rental + Pool + BIKES `Mia Vista Mare`



The Space:

Mia Vista Mare – “My Sea View”



Benvenuto!  Come enjoy our elegant coastal home in Inlet Beach – one of South Walton’s most untouched beach communities. This is a four-bedroom four-bath Gulf Front (a small street between you and the beach) home, designer decorated and featuring many upscale amenities not typically found in rental homes.  You can relax and watch the sun move across the water, sunrise to sunset, from either of our two full-width balconies.  Enjoy refreshments on our top deck as you soak in the stunning views of the nature preserve, beach, and emerald waters.

As you enter the home’s tiled foyer, you will find a king bedroom on your left with a custom walk-in shower. Down the hall, an expansive laundry room with full-sized washer and dryer. The Master Bedroom is at the end of the hall and has a king bed, beautiful shiplap walls, and a writing desk.  The master bath features custom tile work, a soaking tub, rain-head shower, and double vanity.

Up the stairs to the second and third levels, you will find white shiplap walls and full Gulf views from the many windows bringing natural light in the living areas. The second-floor features include sectional seating in the living room, a fireplace, coffered ceilings and a gourmet kitchen fitted with Dacor appliances, a farm sink, and an ice maker. The deck faces the Gulf of Mexico, and the bunk bedroom is located behind the kitchen area and provides a queen bed, along with the twin over twin bunks, and an attached tub/shower bathroom.

The third floor has a large family room, entertainment center, and a second Master king bedroom with tray ceilings. The master en-suite bath provides a standup, tiled shower, and double vanity.  On the front side of the family room is the expansive summer kitchen deck, and includes refrigerator, sink, and counter prep area.  The deck has a table and chairs for dining al-fresco and furniture for relaxing and lounging.



While our home provides all that one needs to “get away from it all”, it also includes high tech features such as large HD TVs in every room, powerful whole-house Wi-Fi, charging stations, and game station to help you stay as connected as you want to be.

The star attraction of this home is its location.  The beach is directly across the street and easily accessed via the Orange Street Beach Access, providing a walkover and comfort station.  The broad walkway leads you across the dunes to miles of pristine, white-sand beaches and sparkling gulf waters.  This beach access provides full services: umbrella and chair rentals, a lifeguard station, and is accessible to all; no stairs mean it’s easy to roll your stroller, wagon, or cooler right out to the sand.





House Rules

**No Pets!**

**No Smoking!**

**No Parties!**

**The primary renter must be at least 25 years old**

**No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25**

**30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**





**With this home you will receive FREE Beach Service.  You will have 2 chairs and 1 umbrella set up for you every morning and taken down each evening.  Leave the heavy lifting to us! Seasonally (March 1st - October 31st)



**30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**



SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (10):

1st Floor - Master Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bath with a soaking tub, rain-head shower, and double vanity

1st Floor - Guest Bedroom - King sized bed, en suite bath with stand-up shower

2nd Floor - Bunk Room - Twin over twin bunk bed, queen bed separate, private bathroom

3rd Floor - Master Bedroom - King sized bed, en-suite bath provides a standup, tiled shower, and double vanity



HOME HIGHLIGHTS:

* Beach Access 30 Seconds South of the Property Featuring Handicap Accessibility

* Community Pool Outside of Backyard

* Includes 1 Beach Set-Ups (2 Chairs and 1 Umbrella)

* 3rd Floor Outdoor Kitchen area

* Unobstructed Gulf Views

* 4 Beach Bike Cruisers Included

* WIFI

* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service



AREA ATTRACTIONS:

We are located in the small intimate Park Place community of eight homes sharing a courtyard pool and lounge area.  Perfect for a quick swim when you’re not on the beach.  In front is a dedicated parking area with room for three cars.  Rosemary Beach and the shops of 30A are a short three-block walk away, or you can peddle there on the bikes we provide with the home.

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The house was absolutely beautiful and very clean when we arrived. The location was perfect! We loved being able to walk to the beach. It's also right outside of Rosemary Beach town, making it easy to get to local amenities, shops, and restaurants. The management team was very responsive and helpful throughout our stay, which we really appreciated. The only downside was the limited supplies provided for our 3-night stay with 6 women, which wasn't quite enough. Aside from that, everything else was great and we truly enjoyed our time there. We will definitely come back! Thanks for hosting us!
